content: Each conversation can belong to multiple groups. Consequently, the dataset needs to be processed to remove duplicates. The dataset resulting after de-duplication contains 295 thousand conversations, each conversation contains on average 6 comments. In total, there are 1.5 million comments. Since the created dataset is multi-threaded, we need to extract conversation threads, to eliminate paths not relevant to the original post.
